seasons.review_body: Taj: Divided by Blood premiered on ZEE5 in March 2023. The 9-episode historical drama depicts the Mughal court of Emperor Akbar and the power struggles among his sons Salim, Murad, and Daniyal over dynastic succession. Stars Naseeruddin Shah as Akbar. A second season, 'Reign of Revenge', followed later in 2023.
